scientific_limitations: Only symmetric equally spaced three-monitor layouts, not arbitrary coordinates, are optimized.
Assumes known Gaussian plume-center uncertainty, fixed hard detection radius, and identical conditionally independent Bernoulli instruments.
Does not model smoke concentration fields, false alarms, weather evolution, failure dependence, deployment expense, or field calibration.
Historical priority is provisional; external independent validation is not performed.
title: Four sharp spacing regimes for a symmetric three-monitor smoke-plume transect
